scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run check:source && npm run build:cloudflare && npm run test:hosting && npm run cf:dry-run
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler dev --local --env preview
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run verify && node _build/cloudflare/preflight.mjs preview && wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.deploy:production: npm run verify && node _build/cloudflare/preflight.mjs production && wrangler deploy
